label: CAR-T style product QC (research / process development). Demo defaults must be confirmed by your QA team; this is not a release specification.

criteria.basis: Demo default for the transduced (CAR+) fraction of the product. Real limits are product- and assay-specific and are set by QA.
Not applicable: the starting material is peripheral blood T cells, so there is no pluripotent population to score. An empty modes list marks a criterion that does not apply to this product.
Genomic integrity of a vector-modified product. For an integrating vector this is where vector copy number and integration-site analysis are reported; the limit and method are set by QA.
